name: Actions compute
description: Net reported runner compute charges after discounts; excludes storage.

name: Actions allowance left
description: Unknown: billing usage reports do not expose an authoritative included allowance.

name: Account Actions minutes
description: Current UTC month runner minutes reported for the connected billing account across its repositories. Selected repository filters do not apply. Excludes free/public usage absent from the billing report.

name: Actions storage accrued
description: Current UTC month Actions storage accrual reported for the connected billing account across its repositories, including reported artifact/cache storage. Selected repository filters do not apply. GB-hours measure storage over time, not bytes currently stored or allowance remaining.

name: Workflow executions
description: Current-month workflow runs in explicitly selected repositories; rerun attempts are not separate executions.

name: Workflow successes
description: Selected repository runs with conclusion success.

name: Workflow failures
description: Selected repository runs with conclusion failure; cancelled/timed-out runs are not counted as failures.

name: Actions artifacts
description: Sum of non-expired artifact bytes in selected repositories; not metered GB-hours or invoice storage.

name: Actions cache
description: Current cache bytes in selected repositories; GitHub may delay updates by five minutes.

name: Packages storage
description: Reported metered storage; never interpreted as current stored GB.

name: Packages transfer
description: Reported billing data transfer; missing or incompatible units remain unknown.

name: Codespaces compute
description: Reported core-hours only; machine-hours with unknown core counts stay unknown.

name: Codespaces storage
description: Reported metered Codespaces storage, not current stored GB.

name: Git LFS storage
description: Reported metered LFS storage when the billing report uses GB-hours.

name: Month billable spend
description: Net metered charges in the current UTC calendar-month report; excludes subscriptions, taxes and invoice adjustments.

name: Repository billable spend
description: Net charges attributed to repositories in the billing report; private repository breakdown in details.

name: Estimated month spend
description: Local low-confidence trend estimate requiring six regular fresh observations over at least 30 minutes.

name: Local target reached in
description: Local low-confidence estimate to an explicit currency target; never a GitHub-enforced limit.
